freeze_rule: Declared before the first model fit. No hyperparameter, feature, threshold or label tuning using heldout results; new experiments require a new version.

data.label_provenance: Repository-authored synthetic relevance labels, not independent human judgments or hiring outcomes. Existing heldout labels and baseline metrics were previously published; this is reused heldout evaluation, not a new blind test.

fit.objective: query-normalized pairwise logistic loss plus L2/2 * squared weight norm
fit.tie_break: ascending within-query candidate id; ids are never features

metrics.aggregation: macro per query; domain and listing-mode slices reported separately

bootstrap.unit: heldout primary domain; both modes kept together

runtime.dependencies: Node22+ plus existing pinned project esbuild; no ML package/model download

fairness_scope: No direct name, email, phone, age, gender, caste, religion, disability, photograph or institution-prestige features. Audit listing-mode and primary-domain slices; demographic fairness cannot be estimated from this synthetic corpus. Semantic text can retain indirect proxies in real data; independent audit required before adoption.
